title: Can I MASTER Earth Day Bots?
summary: The creator plays all five chess.com Earth Day (Apr. 22) bots, endangered/extinct animals that tell nature facts and trash-talk in chat: Diana the Dodo (400), Tim the Turtle, Rhonda the Rhino (1350), Sunny the Snow Leopard (1750) and Wallace the Mammoth (2000). Goal: defeat all five. He wins every game (two by ladder mates after promotion), wonders if the rhino is overrated, and notes it's the first time on the channel he has beaten every one of a monthly bot set.
rules: Normal chess, standard start, one game against each bot in rising rating order.
Each bot chats themed animal facts and trash talk during the game (e.g. Dodo: 'One reason I went extinct is because I never learned to fear humans').
win_condition: Checkmate each of the 5 bots; beating Wallace the Mammoth completes the set.
